keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «꿀벌은 꽃가루를 옮겨 식물이 씨앗과 열매를 맺게 돕는다(주제)» 와 «그래서 꿀벌을 지키는 것이 중요하다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (honeybees carry pollen and help plants make seeds and fruit) and the conclusion (protecting honeybees is important). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: What is the most important fact?
boxes.a: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower
Plants can make seeds and fruit

sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: What happens when a bee visits a flower to drink nectar?
qs.qko: 벌이 꿀을 마시러 꽃에 가면 어떤 일이 생기나요?
opts: Pollen sticks to the tiny hairs on its body
The bee loses all its hairs
evs: When a bee visits a flower to drink sweet nectar, pollen sticks to the tiny hairs on its body.
Pollen is a fine, yellow powder that flowers make.
Farmers depend on bees to pollinate crops such as apples and almonds.
Honeybees are busy insects, and they play a big role in nature.
why: 벌이 꽃꿀을 마시러 꽃에 가면 몸의 작은 털에 꽃가루가 달라붙는다고 했어요.
When a bee visits a flower to drink nectar, pollen sticks to the tiny hairs on its body.

qs.q: In «Farmers depend on bees,» what does «depend on» mean?
qs.qko: «Farmers depend on bees» 에서 «depend on» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Without bees, there would be much less fruit and fewer flowers in the world.
Pollen is a fine, yellow powder that flowers make.
Then the bee flies to another flower of the same kind.
Honeybees are busy insects, and they play a big role in nature.
why: 벌이 없으면 열매가 훨씬 적어진다고 했어요. 그러니 농부들은 벌이 «꼭 필요하다» 는 뜻이에요.
Without bees, there would be much less fruit. So farmers «need» bees.

qs.q: How does a flower get pollen from another flower so it can make seeds?
qs.qko: 꽃은 씨앗을 만들기 위해 다른 꽃의 꽃가루를 어떻게 받나요?
opts: A bee flies to it and some pollen falls off
The wind always brings nectar to it
Farmers paint pollen onto each flower
evs: Then the bee flies to another flower of the same kind.
Pollen is a fine, yellow powder that flowers make.
Some of the pollen falls off and lands on the new flower.
That is why protecting honeybees is important for both nature and people.
why: 벌이 같은 종류의 다른 꽃으로 날아가고, 그때 꽃가루 일부가 떨어져 새 꽃에 앉아요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The bee flies to another flower of the same kind, and some pollen falls off onto the new flower. You need both sentences.

ends: What can we do to help bees?
우리는 벌을 돕기 위해 무엇을 할 수 있을까?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «우리가 해야 할 일 + 그 결과» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and the result in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 넣어 결과를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: so that bees can find food)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + can + what to make the result clear. (e.g. so that bees can find food)
write.src: “We should <u>protect honeybees</u> so that <u>plants can make seeds and fruit</u>.”
